title: Independent uptime and external-owner status declarations
description: Public uptime declaration per service (for example services/<name>/uptime.yaml) and private external-owner status expectations (platform/operations/status.yaml). The uptime host derives from an approved public exposure, never an arbitrary URL; the endpoint must already be intentionally public and safe to probe without user authentication. Enabling status declares an expectation of bounded execution evidence; missing evidence stays visibly unavailable and a disabled executor never appears healthy.

exposureReference.description: Approved public exposure naming the probed host. YAML never authorizes publishing a private service.

path.description: Health path on the approved exposure. No credentials, query strings or private endpoints.

expectedStatus.description: Only 200 with the expected uncached health body is supported.

intervalSeconds.description: Only the accepted five-minute Free check interval is supported.

notificationProfile.description: Approved private notification profile; contact details stay private.

name.description: External owner root supported by infra/status.contract.json.

enabled.description: Enabled roots must publish bounded redacted evidence; disabled roots report unavailable.

maximumObservationAgeSeconds.description: Evidence older than this is stale, never healthy.
